basics.name: Jeano Ermitaño
basics.summary: Senior ICT Leader and Master of Information Systems (UPOU). As Program Head, I directed 20+ professionals to drive 70% service adoption of 1,000+ stakeholders. Specialist in consultancy and security awareness training, integrated with a technical practice in penetration testing, SIEM operations, and vulnerability research.

work.name: STI College Las Piñas
highlights: Strategic Leadership: Directed a team of 20+ professionals using Agile mindset; managed the end-to-end talent lifecycle including onboarding, technical training, performance review, and administrative support.
Operational Excellence: Achieved a 70% increase in service adoption by pioneering client engagement opportunities; maintained growth through optimal resource allocation and process automation.

Crisis Management: Served as a subject matter expert and consultant for the digital transformation of onsite services to online platforms during the pandemic, ensuring business continuity for 1,000+ stakeholders.

Security Advocacy: Championed institutional cyber hygiene and security awareness training; provided cybersecurity mentorship resulting in 3 successful EC-Council Ethical Hacking certifications; internally disclose vulnerabilities using TTP mapped to the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

Compliance: Audited service delivery to ensure compliance with curriculum and operational expectations served as technical panel during BSIT and BSCS capstone presentation to ensure project integrity.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Worked with Admissions department for client acquisition activities; resolved high-level escalations from Registrar and Guidance offices; served as technical consultant on infrastructure for the MIS department; coordinated partnerships with both student and professional organizations.

work.name: Personiv
highlights: Global Change Management: Served as a subject matter expert in Gurugram, India to manage web designer expectations during migration to a new design tool, while assisting in Level 2 escalations from America.
Operational Excellence: Exceeded SLA by producing new website builds in under 4 hours, website re-design in under 3 hours, and website modifications in under 1 hour.
Compliance: Audited SEO and website performance using Google Lighthouse; Conducted regional research to localize web assets, ensuring environmental and cultural relevance of website design.
